arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Valid versions
print('1.2.3:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3'))
print('0.0.0:', VersionInfo.isvalid('0.0.0'))
print('10.20.30:', VersionInfo.isvalid('10.20.30'))
print('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.4:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.4'))
print('1.0.0-rc.1:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.0.0-rc.1'))
print('1.0.0+build:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.0.0+build'))

# Invalid versions
print('invalid:', VersionInfo.isvalid('invalid'))
print('1.2:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2'))
print('v1.2.3:', VersionInfo.isvalid('v1.2.3'))
print('1.2.3.4:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3.4'))
print('01.2.3:', VersionInfo.isvalid('01.2.3'))
print('1.02.3:', VersionInfo.isvalid('1.02.3'))
"
